_doc: Where the player is right now, per game: which RAM to read and how it maps to the location ids the met-location tables use (gen 2: locations_gen2_crystal.json landmark ids, gen 3: locations_gen3.json MAPSEC ids, gen 4: gen4.json locations). Gen 1 has no met location: its ids are this file's gen1Locations (town-map names). Read by shared/live/location.mjs.
_generated: scratchpad h/genmaps.py from the pret clones (pokered/pokeyellow/pokegold/pokecrystal master, pokeheartgold/pokeplatinum/pokediamond master) + PKHeX master. Re-run to regenerate.

gen1._doc: map id (constants/map_constants.asm) -> gen1Locations id, by the town map (data/maps/town_map_entries.asm ExternalMapEntries/InternalMapEntries, home/... LoadTownMapEntry)

gen2._doc: "group.number" (data/maps/maps.asm MapGroupPointers order, 1-based) -> Crystal landmark id (locations_gen2_crystal.json). Gold/Silver landmarks are matched to Crystal ids by constant name (Crystal adds LANDMARK_BATTLE_TOWER).

gen4._doc: map id -> location (met location) id. hgss: pokeheartgold src/data/map_headers.h .mapsec; pt: pokeplatinum include/data/map_headers.h .mapLabelTextID (index into res/text/location_names.json); dp: pokediamond arm9/src/map_header.c sMapHeaders[].mapsec

gen4Music._doc: map id -> BGM sequence number of the map (day music). hgss: pokeheartgold src/data/map_headers.h .dayMusicId, include/constants/sndseq.h
